title.narrative: Tonga Disaster Governance and Adaptive Capacity Strengthening Project

description.narrative: Tonga is one of the world’s most exposed countries to natural hazards. The recent eruption of the Hunga Tonga-Hunga Ha’apai volcano – followed by a tsunami and more than 70 earthquakes (magnitudes 4.4-5.0) between 14 January and 04 February 2022 – devastated the country and identified weaknesses in the emergency management system in Tonga. The compounding and cascading nature of hazards affecting Tonga poses a very different set of risks to its recovering economy and more broadly human development. Anchored in the four workstreams of the Sendai Framework for DRR, the Government of Tonga’s Strategic Development Framework (TSDF II), and the DRM Act (2021), this initial project will build on the existing work currently undertaken in Tonga by the past recovery project.
